payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (commit e3c026d). frick init now scaffolds the Rust-DSL authoring loop: a buildable binary crate whose src/main.rs defines the schema via frick-schema SchemaBuilder (between frick:schema markers) and, on cargo run, writes schema.json (for the standalone frick-server via FRICK_SCHEMA_PATH) + regenerates the Swift/Kotlin/TS SDKs through frick-codegen. Cargo.toml deps selectable via --crate-deps path|version|git (path-into-repo default so the loop is real in-monorepo). A TS schema/client surface remains as an optional secondary surface (no @fricken/server dep). Salvaged from the stalled worktree agent + fixed the dep-pin test. frick-cli tests green.
